title: Toward sustainable fuel formulations: thermophysical assessment of a synthetic oxygenated blend formed from hexane + cyclopentyl methyl ether + propan-1-ol
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00759C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Isaías Huenuvil-Pacheco, Marcela Cartes, Andrés Mejía
This study provides a comprehensive thermophysical characterization of a new potential oxygenate fuel composed of hexane as a surrogate for fossil fuel, cyclopentyl methyl ether (CPME) as a synthetic fuel, and propan-1-ol as a biofuel.
